name: Spotify Deck · 2.4" CYD (resistive)
body: The network deck: it signs in to Spotify with a refresh token, draws what is playing and sends previous, play/pause and next from the screen's three chips. Mono ink on paper, same as its sibling.
notes: First boot opens a WiFi access point called Spotify Deck and serves a setup page at http://192.168.4.1: join it from the phone, type the WiFi password and a Spotify client id and let it join your network. Pair the deck in this app once with the address it prints, then SIGN IN starts the whole thing from here: Spotify's reply comes back to the app, the app hands the code to the deck and the deck stores the token. Without the app the page at http://<deck-ip>/spotify takes the address the browser lands on. Hold the SETUP chip in the footer, or type setup + Enter at 115200, to run it again; hold the screen four seconds at boot to forget the stored credentials.
